judgements.reason: Preconditions hold and are reinforced. This week's bridges -- Unsloth Studio MCP-connected local agent (06-03, `because`) and the RTX/DGX Dev Box running 120B models locally (06-04, `so_that`) -- continue to materialize the `because` (edge-runnable coding-agent quality) and the `so_that` (local-by-default-then-overflow). Nothing resolves or contradicts the Q3-2026 standardization claim.

Newest bridges (06-04, 06-03, plus the 06-01 RTX Spark OEM-laptop landing) are supportive and accurately scoped, each noting the gap (deploy-pipeline vs runtime overflow). No contradict-direction bridge.

All three Needs (sub-40B>70% SWE-bench model; local-first router GA with measured cloud-overflow tail; 600+ tok/s consumer-GPU runtime) remain open (target Q3 2026). No GA local-first-default router shipped this week; Dev Box is a workstation, not a harness defaulting to local. No actor delivered.

Chain edges (Bonsai 1-bit feasibility, 27B-Dense standardization downstream, enterprise-hybrid downstream, 1M-context floor, closed-weight-frontier split) and parallel relations stable; no upstream landing/contradiction or new edge this week.
